issue.title: Bug: PDU is connected to the the switch-host in the topo not to the BMC

resolution.title: Additional patch needed in thermal_leak_sensor switch_host_module bmcctld and thermalctld tests
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
Fixes seen needed on additional test runs with Switch-Host

Summary:

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26229 https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26230 https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26232

Following additional fixes added
1. In the platform API test test_switch_host_status_control(), no need to check admin_status as it won't change with the platform_api call to shut and unshut the switch-host
2. In the test test_leak_sensor_status_attributes() handle the case when the leakseverity is defined as an Enum and platform API server's obj_serialize cannot serialize the Enum members
3. Fix test_bmcctld_event_trigger to handle the 'None' leak_orig_state and handle the power_down and power_up
4. Use the switch Host DUT PDU defined to power off in test_bmcctld_power_on_delay(). Usually we will not define PDU for BMC DUT
5. Skip few tests in tests/platform_tests/daemon/test_thermalctld.py explicitly till we have the mock APIs available to create a leak or create a fault sensor.
